notes: P5: NavRail (10b-spec). Closed = the passive 44 dp strip; open = the 288 dp panel (strip alpha 1->0, panel -288->0 over 280 ms).
Opened by LEFT on the hero's Play (10d §4: left on button 0 -> requestRailOpen). Focus lands on the active section's item (Home, index 1).
Items in order: 0 search (icon only), 1 home, 2 movies, 3 shows, 4 list, 5 ai, [spacer], 6 settings, 7 profile pill.

UP at item 0 wraps to the profile pill unless focusJustMoved(120): the states reach each item with DOWN steps 150 ms apart (keyGapMs) so no wrap is triggered, except 'item-profile-wrap' which tests the wrap after a pause.
RailHues loops hold phase 0.37 under freeze.

states.name: closed
states.note: collapsed strip only (passive): the rail mark over the dots, hues frozen

states.name: open
states.note: panel open, strip faded, focus on 'Home' (lit); the slide and the strip alpha traced

states.name: item-home
states.note: same as 'open' — kept as its own row so the per-item table is complete

states.name: item-settings
states.note: 'Settings' (icon gear 19 + label) lit, across the flex spacer

states.name: item-profile
states.note: the profile pill lit (avatar + name of the 'Claude QA' profile)

states.name: item-profile-wrap
states.note: UP at Search after a pause wraps to the profile pill; must equal 'item-profile'

states.name: closed-again
states.note: RIGHT closes; focus returns to the captured element (Play); must equal 'closed'
